review_text: Microtransaction hell-hole. This game still feels great to play, then you look in the store for a PAID game and see all the stuff that should have been earned cosmetic loot from exciting missions behind (sometimes not small) monetary walls and remember that you're just being milked.  They give you just enough """"free"""" (not free at all you pay for every season) content to keep you engaged while clearly putting more effort into the in-game store than the game itself. It used to be that the in game store had most of the paid cosmetics available to be earned though bright dust, or paid for by silver (real money) if you couldn't be bothered to save up dust (fake in game money), which while annoying was fine I guess. Now almost everything is real money only. Also you cant play like 90% of the story anymore because content vaulting was deemed OK.
reason: Criticises paid cosmetics and emphasis on the store

review_text:
This has been coming for a long time.

I miss you so much Destiny 😢😿 I hope someday you find safely, away from your cruel and extortionate creators.


Me and my clan have spent thousands of hours, playing over generations of consoles. Now none of my clan remain.

I don't mean to sound dramatic or like an old record but.

I payed full price for the game on day one. And then I payed full price for DLC content, repeatedly... GREAT! 👍....
It was perfect! (I'm only slightly exaggerating).

And then it happened. 😢😭🤢🤮

It felt like we lost everything that day, the day when Beyond Light came and took everything from us. And then! AND THEN!  We were expected to pay for absolutely EVERYTHING!. Honestly, I still can't wrap my head around it. You seriously want me to pay for the game again?
And again?
And again??
AND AGAIN???

Didn't you get bought by Sony? Why do you need me to keep giving you handouts, just so you can remove content. And replace it, in a game EVERYONE HAD ALREADY PAYED FOR,
In a game that worked great, people enjoyed and nobody ask you to delete.

And to be reskining as much as you do, holy hell!!! Stop it!

I couldn't care less about the seasons. They make me feel sick. It's just the old progression system, sliced out of the game and sold back to us. Only it's quality is way worse. I don't understand how it isn't clearly a PAY TO WIN system.  

In your quest to not over-deliver you have significantly under-delivered in almost everything.

I think It might be time to accept that the magic is never going to come back.

I'm sorry fellow Guardians, I didn't think it would go so wrong. 😢
reason: Criticises repeated charges and removal of purchased content
